title: How html-explain works
subtitle: the plugin itself · round 1
summary: An agent studies a system and writes a spec: boxes in zones and arrows between them. A build step turns the spec into this page. You leave notes on boxes, copy them back, and the agent answers them in place and draws an After view.

zones.title: You
zones.why: Where a session starts and where notes come from.

zones.title: The skill
zones.why: What the agent reads before it writes anything.

zones.title: The review loop
zones.flow: ↺ your notes come back as answers in place and changes in the After view

zones.title: Page runtime
zones.why: The JavaScript inside every built page.

nodes.title: You
nodes.desc: Run `/html-explain <what to explain>`: a whole repo, a module, or a question like "how does auth work".

nodes.title: SKILL.md
nodes.desc: The steps the agent follows: explore, write the spec, build, then answer notes round by round.

nodes.title: Spec reference
nodes.desc: Every field of the spec with an example: zones, boxes, arrows, the After view, threads.

nodes.title: Example spec
nodes.desc: This page's own spec, to copy from.

nodes.title: Explore
nodes.desc: The agent reads the code the focus points at: modules, sizes, what calls what, and why things are the way they are.

nodes.title: Spec
nodes.desc: The source of the page: zones, boxes with short plain descriptions, arrows, and red-dot notes on what may not fit a simple design.

nodes.title: After view
nodes.desc: The proposed system: boxes that change, go or appear, and a list of your notes with where each one lands.

nodes.title: Build
nodes.desc: Checks the spec and writes one HTML file with the runtime and the spec inside it. No network, no dependencies.

nodes.title: Spec check
nodes.desc: Unknown zones, nodes, arrows and thread keys stop the build with a message.

nodes.title: The page
nodes.desc: What you read: click a box to see what it does and what it connects to.

nodes.title: Notes
nodes.desc: Each box and the page itself takes notes. They stay in your browser until you copy them with Notes for the agent.

nodes.title: Render
nodes.desc: Lays out zones and boxes, and draws the arrows of the selected box.
nodes.note: Finding one box on a large page means scanning every zone by eye.

nodes.title: Side panel
nodes.desc: Shows the selected box: its description, what changes, its arrows, and its conversation.

nodes.title: Note store
nodes.desc: Unsent notes, kept per page. A note the agent filed in the spec's threads disappears from it.

nodes.title: Page file
nodes.desc: One file you can open, share or commit.

nodes.title: Spec file
nodes.desc: The source; the agent edits it each round.

after.label: After
after.summary: Round 1 adds a search box: type a name and the page selects the box.

render.change: Selects the box a search names.

add.title: Search box
add.desc: Type part of a box's name or file; the first match is selected and its arrows drawn.

notes.q: How do I find one box on a big page?
notes.a: Today by eye. The After view adds a search box.

node:render.text: How do I find one box on a big page?
Today you scan the zones by eye. The After view adds a search box that selects the first box whose name or file matches.
